package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	httpmw "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
)

type StudentOnboardingGetter interface {
	Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentOnboarding, error)
}

type StudentOnboardingPutter interface {
	Handle(ctx context.Context, input studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingInput) (domain.StudentOnboarding, error)
}

type StudentOnboardingHandler struct {
	Get           StudentOnboardingGetter
	Put           StudentOnboardingPutter
	GetDraft      StudentOnboardingDraftGetter
	PutDraft      StudentOnboardingDraftPutter
	FinalizeDraft StudentOnboardingDraftFinalizer
}

func (handler StudentOnboardingHandler) GetProfile(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if handler.Get == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student onboarding is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	profile, err := handler.Get.Handle(r.Context(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, profile)
}

func (handler StudentOnboardingHandler) PutProfile(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if handler.Put == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student onboarding is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var payload struct {
		ExpectedVersion        int64    `json:"expected_version"`
		DirectionCode          string   `json:"direction_code"`
		SelfAssessedExperience string   `json:"self_assessed_experience"`
		KnownStacks            []string `json:"known_stacks"`
		DesiredStacks          []string `json:"desired_stacks"`
		GoalCode               string   `json:"goal_code"`
		GoalText               string   `json:"goal_text"`
		PreferredLanguage      string   `json:"preferred_language"`
		WeeklyMinutes          int      `json:"weekly_minutes"`
		PreferredPace          string   `json:"preferred_pace"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 64<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	profile, err := handler.Put.Handle(r.Context(), studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingInput{
		StudentID: studentID, ExpectedVersion: payload.ExpectedVersion,
		DirectionCode: payload.DirectionCode, SelfAssessedExperience: payload.SelfAssessedExperience,
		KnownStacks: payload.KnownStacks, DesiredStacks: payload.DesiredStacks,
		GoalCode: payload.GoalCode, GoalText: payload.GoalText,
		PreferredLanguage: payload.PreferredLanguage, WeeklyMinutes: payload.WeeklyMinutes,
		PreferredPace: payload.PreferredPace,
	})
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		http.Error(w, "onboarding version conflict", http.StatusConflict)
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, profile)
}
